title: Console pin does not build on main: objectui daeb77fc imports checkPageComponentViewData, deleted from spec by #23784
body:
**Filing gate ①**: a product defect with a named landing and a reproduction (reach: the public build entry `pnpm objectui:build` on `main`, which fails on every run).

**Reader who acts:** the spec-lane seat that owns the #23784 surface. It either restores a deprecated `checkPageComponentViewData` re-export, or coordinates the objectui import removal and moves `.objectui-sha` to that commit. It pairs with an objectui card filed by a seat that can reach objectstack-ai/objectui.

## What

On `main` at `94114c1f`, the vendored console cannot be built at its own pin. `pnpm objectui:build` (→ `scripts/build-console.sh`, which injects THIS tree's `@objectstack/spec` via `OBJECTSTACK_SPEC_DIST`) fails in the objectui console's `vite build`:

```
[MISSING_EXPORT] "checkPageComponentViewData" is not exported by "packages/spec/dist/ui/index.mjs".
  ../../packages/types/src/zod/layout.zod.ts:19
✗ Build failed · ERR_PNPM_RECURSIVE_RUN_FIRST_FAIL @object-ui/console build · exit 1
```

So every fresh tree on `main` (a contributor's, a QA runner's, a release build that runs `objectui:build`) has no `/_console/` until this is resolved.

## Reproduction

1. Fresh checkout of `main` at `94114c1f` (`.objectui-sha` = `daeb77fc84dd824e74c95b87cdede85afdb248e7`).
2. `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build` → 75/75 green.
3. `pnpm objectui:build` → exit 1 with the `MISSING_EXPORT` above.

Expected: the console builds at the pin (exit 0, `packages/console/dist/.objectui-sha` stamped `daeb77fc…`). Actual: the build dies at rendering chunks.

Control: the same objectui pin builds clean (exit 0, 64588 KB dist, the single-zod canary and the spec-injection assertion both pass) when the injected spec comes from `a35f7a67^`, the commit just before the deletion.

## Mechanism

- `a35f7a67` (#23784, merged 2026-10-16 10:27Z) deleted `checkPageComponentViewData` from `packages/spec/src/ui` (the follow-up card #23447). `packages/spec/src/ui/object-refinement-check-exports.test.ts` now pins its absence (0 declarations).
- objectui at the pin `daeb77fc` imports it in `packages/types/src/zod/layout.zod.ts:19` (line 25 on objectui `main` `a5bb7ac2`, read 2026-10-16 11:15Z). So objectui `main` has the same import, and **bumping the pin alone does not fix it**.
- Fix direction (either order, both repos): objectui drops the import (the component-props rule replaced it), then this repo's pin moves to that commit. Alternatively, this repo restores a deprecated re-export until the pin moves. Which one is the spec-lane owner's call. The breaking deletion landed without a pin that builds against it.

## Why nothing went red

Per-PR CI does not build the console at the pin against the PR's spec. Read the `Console Pin Gate` on the hourly full battery after `a35f7a67` to confirm whether it caught this.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack, closed included: `checkPageComponentViewData console build objectui pin missing export` → 8 hits. Read: #23447 (closed, the deletion card itself), #22472, #20456, #5576, #7973, #6776, #7121, #6953. None reports the console build breaking. objectstack-ai/objectui is not reachable from this session (access denied), so it was not searched.

QA-source: #23878 · platform-core.boot-health · console mount precondition (environment), found while preparing the browser legs of the full-checklist run. The run records link back here.
